                      messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>

                      sourceRef="Task_SendEmail" targetRef="Participant_Engineer"
                      messageRef="Message_EngineerEmail"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OEE" name="Start measuring">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_To_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeMeasurementCycles" name="Continue measuring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_To_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AboveThreshold_To_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Restarted_To_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_To_EventGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForMachineEvent" name="Wait for machine data or disconnection"
                            eventGatewayType="Exclusive" instantiate="false">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_To_EventGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EventGateway_To_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EventGateway_To_Disconnected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant machine information"
                      messageRef="Message_MachineData">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EventGateway_To_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_To_Calculate</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_To_Calculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Calculate_To_Threshold</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BelowThreshold_To_Stop</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AboveThreshold_To_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stop_To_Email</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RestartGateway_To_Restarted</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RestartGateway_To_Disconnected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Restarted_To_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_MachineRestarted"

    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EventGateway_To_Disconnected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RestartGateway_To_Disconnected</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disconnected_To_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_MachineDisconnected"
                                  messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineDisconnected" name="Process stopped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disconnected_To_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_To_Merge" sourceRef="StartEvent_OEE" targetRef="Gateway_MergeMeasurementCycles"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_To_EventGateway" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeMeasurementCycles" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForMachineEvent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EventGateway_To_Collect" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForMachineEvent" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EventGateway_To_Disconnected" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForMachineEvent" targetRef="Event_MachineDisconnected"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_To_Email" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_SendEmail"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RestartGateway_To_Restarted" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnect" targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RestartGateway_To_Disconnected" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForRestartOrDisconnect" targetRef="Event_MachineDisconnected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restarted_To_Merge" sourceRef="Event_MachineRestarted" targetRef="Gateway_MergeMeasurementCycles"/>

rules.instruction: When the description identifies multiple independent activities that must all be completed before a later activity can begin: model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize them with a parallel join before the later activity
rules.situation: the description requires collecting multiple independent inputs before calculating a result

rules.instruction: When the description says that work resumes or continues after an interruption or restart: model the resumed work as an activity in the existing process flow, rather than as a start event representing that work
rules.situation: the description says that work resumes or continues after an interruption or restart

rules.instruction: Model every distinct activity, event, participant, decision, branch, loop, message and outcome stated in the description. Do not invent process facts.
rules.situation: the description states that a disconnection stops an ongoing process
